cohort: 590 women who gave birth at Tai'an City Central Hospital between January and December 2017 (144 TOLAC, 152 VBNC, 152 RCS, and 142 PCS)
finding: TOLAC was found to be as safe and feasible as VBNC, and more favorable to the safety of mother and fetus than RCS.
mod_finding: There were no significant differences in labor time, postpartum hemorrhage, Apgar scores, hospital stay, or puerperal morbidity between the VBAC and VBNC groups.
